_meta.description: Open the Create API key dialog in Google AI Studio, fill the key name, and STOP before the final submit. A human must click 'Create key' to avoid bot detection.

key_name.description: Display name for the new API key

project.description: GCP project ID — used as URL param to pre-select project in dialog

botDetection.wall: Google server-side bot detection on 'Create key' submit — returns 'Failed to generate API key, The request is suspicious' for automated clicks.
botDetection.strategy: Recipe stops after filling the key name. Human must click 'Create key' to complete.
botDetection.humanStep: Click the 'Create key' button in the open dialog.

_meta.selectorNotes: The 'Create API key' page button shares class ms-button-primary with the nav toggle, account switcher, and ToS dismiss banner. Use text-content matching (abstractTarget create-api-key-btn) not bare CSS. Dialog input has stable aria-label 'Name your key'. Dialog submit has stable combined class xap-inline-dialog ms-button-primary.

create-api-key-btn.description: Main 'Create API key' button on the API keys list page. Uses text matching because ms-button-primary class is shared with nav toggle, account switcher, and banner dismiss buttons.

key-name-input.description: Key name text input inside the Create API key dialog. The id attribute is a generated UUID and changes per session — use aria-label instead.

chain.note: Click 'Create API key'. Text matching resolves to the correct button even when ms-button-primary banner/dismiss buttons are present.
Fill the key name. aria-label 'Name your key' is stable.

STOP — bot detection wall. Read dialog state for confirmation that name is filled. Human must click 'Create key' (button.xap-inline-dialog.ms-button-primary) to submit. DO NOT automate the final click.
